privacy: Your file stays on this device.
formats: Choose or drop a photo, TIFF, icon, HEIC, JPEG XL or JPEG 2000 still image.
unsupported: This file is not a supported raster image. Check the format rather than its filename extension.
invalid: The image is damaged or uses an unsupported encoding.
sequence: This container uses an unsupported JPEG 2000 variant or timed sequence. Open an individual JP2, J2K or other supported still image instead.
engineError: The image decoder could not start. Check your connection and reopen the file.
resourceLimit: Your browser ran out of resources while opening this image. Try closing other tabs or use another device.
renderError: The browser could not display this preview. Reopen the file or try another device.
panHint: Drag to pan, or focus the image and use the arrow keys.
animation: Animation is shown as individual, composited frames. Playback is unavailable.
poster: Animated PNG: only the default still image is shown. Animation frames are unavailable.
precision: This is an 8-bit preview. High bit depth and HDR are reduced; colors may differ from a color-managed editor.
compatibility: Embedded profiles are retained where supported. Auxiliary images, depth maps and container metadata are not shown.
pngNote: Save the selected image as an 8-bit PNG. High bit depth and HDR are reduced. Zoom and preview backgrounds do not change the saved image.

jpgExport.qualityHint: 1–100. Higher quality usually makes a larger file. Press Enter or leave the field to apply.
jpgExport.note: Preview the actual JPG before saving. JPG is lossy, uses 8-bit color and fills transparency with the selected JPG background. Zoom and preview backgrounds do not change the saved image.
jpgExport.compatibility: JPG output is converted to sRGB. Embedded source profiles are used where supported; colors may differ from a color-managed editor. Auxiliary images, depth maps and container metadata are not preserved.
